name: Hair Loss
title: Hair loss, read honestly
description: Traction alopecia, CCCA, alopecia areata, DHT and shedding, explained by certified trichologists and clinically reviewed. Serving all of Metro Atlanta.
intro: Traction, CCCA, round patches, DHT and shedding. What each pattern looks like, what it's commonly linked to, and what a 200x read shows that the mirror can't.

hero.alt: A woman parts her natural hair at the crown in a bathroom mirror, checking her scalp up close.
hero.caption: Where it thins says a lot about why.

shortVersion.text: Hair loss has patterns, and the pattern is the first clue. Thinning at the edges, a crown that spreads outward, round smooth patches and all-over shedding each point somewhere different, which is why we look before anyone recommends a treatment.
takeaways: Where it thins says a lot about why.
Early is when options are widest.
Scarred follicles do not regrow, so protecting what's active comes first.

name: Scalp Concerns
title: Your scalp, up close
description: Oily scalp, itch, flaking and buildup, and how scalp health connects to hair growth. Written by certified trichologists. Serving all of Metro Atlanta.
intro: Oil, itch, flaking and buildup. What's commonly going on at the surface, and how the health of your scalp shapes the hair growing out of it.

shortVersion.text: Your scalp is skin, and the follicles live in it. When it's oily, itchy, flaking or irritated, that's a signal worth reading before you switch products again. At 200x we can see what the surface is actually doing around each follicle.
takeaways: Healthy hair starts with a healthy scalp.
Itch and oil are signals worth reading.
200x shows what the surface is doing.
